description: Summary of the model identity and cross-vendor distinction proof corpus. Every identity mismatch is exercised; cross-vendor review is permitted only when canonical observed identities are genuinely distinct.
distinction_rule: Both canonical observed harness AND canonical observed model must differ between implementer and reviewer. Different harness alone or different model alone is not cross-vendor. Both observed provenances must be the isolated omnigent chat.db root conversation seam. Conversation IDs and roles must also differ.

permitted.name: codex-gpt5_vs_claude-sdk-sonnet
permitted.description: Different harness (codex vs claude-sdk) AND different model (gpt-5 vs claude-sonnet-4-5) — genuine distinction

permitted.name: droid-glm_vs_codex-gpt5
permitted.description: Different harness (droid vs codex) AND different model (glm-5.2 vs gpt-5) — genuine distinction

denied.name: same_observed_identity
denied.description: Same harness AND same model — not genuinely distinct

denied.name: same_observed_harness
denied.description: Same harness, different model — harness alone is not cross-vendor

denied.name: same_observed_model
denied.description: Different harness, same model — model alone is not cross-vendor

denied.name: missing_implementer_observed_identity
denied.description: Implementer observed receipt has wrong producer — label-only, no real observation

denied.name: missing_reviewer_observed_identity
denied.description: Reviewer observed receipt has wrong producer — label-only, no real observation

denied.name: missing_implementer_conversation_id
denied.description: Implementer conversation ID is null — no root conversation

denied.name: missing_reviewer_conversation_id
denied.description: Reviewer conversation ID is null — no root conversation

denied.name: same_conversation_id
denied.description: Same conversation ID — same process/session, not independent

denied.name: spoofed_implementer_provenance
denied.description: Implementer observed provenance is not the chat.db seam

denied.name: spoofed_reviewer_provenance
denied.description: Reviewer observed provenance is not the chat.db seam

capability_activation.reason: Cross-vendor review is permitted only when the canonical observed identities of implementer and reviewer are genuinely distinct (different harness AND model); same-identity requests are rejected.
